_comment: Player factions (server\guilds.js). Separate from hold offices in zones.json/officials.json. Each faction lists its ranks top to bottom; every rank maps to one role, and the role decides the permissions (roles below). Secret factions (the Daedric cults, the Thieves Guild, the Dark Brotherhood, Clan Volkihar) show their roster only to their own members. Membership lives in guilds.json (runtime, gitignored). A hall's doors are the ways in; its cells (optional) are the interior cells that are the hall though no listed door stands in them (the Cathedral of St Martin, whose doors stand in the street; the Synod Conclave's main hall): a Scholars' Ledger or Class Lectern there is that faction's for teaching, and its sales pay that faction's treasury.

factions.name: Imperial Civil Commission
factions.note: Nate 9 Oct 2026: the Elder Council's civil arm in the province: Imperial justice, charters and licences, audits of the holds (Lex Imperii I.3, VII). Titles from the Lex Imperii (Praetor, Agent-Inspector, Clerk), the games (Magistrate) and the Council's own letter (Civil Commissioner). Rules no county: the Count keeps county justice. Small by design: staff seat the Commissioner.

factions.name: Penitus Oculatus
factions.note: Nate 9 Oct 2026: the Mede dynasty's own eyes, sword and shield (UESP Lore:Penitus Oculatus; ranks Commander, Inspector, Agent, Recruit are attested). Answers to the Emperor, not the Civil Commission: a Magistrate may request the Oculatus, never order it. Wears the Penitus Oculatus set beside the Legion. Staff seat the Commander.

factions.name: The Imperial Cult
factions.note: Nate 11 Oct 2026: the Empire's official worship of the Divines, its religious arm. No hall yet: the Cathedral of St Martin belongs to the Great Faiths, a neutral order (Aldemar, 11 Oct). Titles are the Imperial Cult's own ladder (Morrowind: Initiate, Acolyte, Adept, Disciple, Oracle, Invoker, Theurgist, Primate; a chapel is led by a Primate in Oblivion). The Eight Divines: Talos worship is outlawed under the White-Gold Concordat (4E 211). Staff seat the Primate. Its tome shop and teaching wait for a chapel of its own.

factions.name: The Great Faiths
factions.note: Nate 11 Oct 2026 (option A): the players' order of the Eight Divines that runs the Cathedral of St Martin in Bruma (and, since 19 Oct, Solitude's Temple of the Divines), led by Sylvia Dawnveil (its notice: 'Priests and Knights of all Eight Divines'). Neutral: not the Empire's Imperial Cult. At the Cathedral it sells Restoration and Alteration tomes to its own by rank as the colleges do, its Senior ranks (Priest and up) teach those schools, and its sermons offer their spell. The leader may rename the ranks. Staff seat the High Priest.
